name: EveryInfra TikTok
description: Query public TikTok data with EveryInfra: video search, video details and transcripts, comments, profiles and videos, hashtags, follower counts, shop products and creators.

description_en: Query public TikTok data: video search, video details and transcripts, comments, profiles and videos, hashtags, follower counts, shop products and creators. Connect with your EveryInfra API key; pay per call.
examples_zh: 搜索 TikTok 上关于 portable blender 的热门视频
